subject: Charter Review Orientation
overview: The Charter Study Committee met to review legal guidelines with KP Law and receive an introductory presentation from the Collins Center for Public Management on Massachusetts charter review processes. The committee also approved previous minutes and established its future meeting schedule.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the December 12, 2022 meeting.

items.title: Open Meeting and Public Records Law Presentation
items.summary: Janelle Austin of KP Law provided guidance on open meeting law compliance, public records standards, electronic communications, and state ethics requirements.

items.title: Collins Center Charter Review Overview and Discussion
items.summary: Representatives from the Collins Center for Public Management presented on Massachusetts charter history and review pathways, after which committee members introduced themselves and discussed project priorities.

items.title: Future Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The committee scheduled its next meeting for February 8, 2023, and agreed to establish a standing meeting on the first Thursday of each month starting in March.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Residents addressed the committee to express appreciation for the charter review effort.
